messages:
mira: Hey team, filing a support escalation from ACME (customer). They intermittently hit 403 when switching projects in the Console right after SSO login. Repro steps and payloads below.

mira: Repro steps (customer): 1) SSO login via Okta 2) click project switch dropdown 3) console buttons are greyed, API call to /v1/projects/:id/switch returns 403 with body: {"error":"permission_denied", "missing_scope":"project:write"}. Happens ~30% of attempts, resolves after a browser refresh or new SSO flow.

samir: Can you paste the request/response headers + any auth logs? Sounds like a delegated-scope truncation.

mira: Partial headers (redacted):
Authorization: Bearer eyJ...REDACTED...
X-Forwarded-User: admin@acme.com
X-Request-ID: 01f4a6..
Response: 403, content-type: application/json, body: {"error":"permission_denied","missing_scope":"project:write"}

alex: Seen this pattern before when the auth proxy or idp refresh race strips on-behalf-of scopes. Any SCIM/group sync or admin changes around that time?

mira: Customer timeline: 2025-06-04T14:12Z login, 14:13Z tried switch -> 403, 14:15Z refresh -> success. They reported an Okta group sync around 14:13Z.

support-bot: Thank you — logging this to the ticket and tagging eng-infra. @eng-infra

priya: I'm looking now. Can you provide the raw auth log entries for 14:12-14:18Z (redact tokens) and the user id? I'll grep the token-issue service.

mira: Sent logs via secure share (redacted token strings). In our logs I see: 
2025-06-04T14:12:10Z auth-service INFO user=acct-831 token_scopes="project:read project:write" session_id=sess-123
2025-06-04T14:13:07Z scim-sync INFO group=engs users=acme-team resync=start
2025-06-04T14:13:09Z auth-service INFO user=acct-831 token_scopes="project:read" session_id=sess-123
2025-06-04T14:15:02Z ui-client INFO user=acct-831 performed project-switch status=200

priya: That sequence is illuminating — token_scopes lost project:write right after SCIM resync. Looks like a race: SCIM group attribute normalized removed a claim, which caused session re-issue without delegated scope.

samir: Does the proxy actively re-issue sessions on SCIM changes? If not, session stays with stale/partial scopes or a newly minted token lacks the delegated claim.

alex: Quick mitigation: 1) Instruct customer to generate a personal API key (console -> API keys) and use it for project-switch actions until we patch (works because API keys bypass delegated-scope flow). 2) Server-side: treat missing scope in console-only routes as 'check current group membership' and allow if backend confirms group grants that permission (audit required).

mira: Customer accepted the workaround and regained access. We'll do KB article.

priya: Long-term fix options: A) Make SCIM resync trigger session refresh + retain delegated scopes, B) Add short debounce on claim propagation so sessions in-flight are not re-issued mid-action, C) Add a targeted auth-proxy canary change to re-evaluate scopes on critical console endpoints. I'm going to open INF ticket and schedule a canary.

alex: Recommend also adding better telemetry: log when a session loses delegated scopes and correlate with SCIM events — helps root-cause diagnosis across tenants.

mira: Agreed. I'll draft the KB and notify customer. Thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:

priya: INF-4821 opened, priority P2, assignees priya/alex, notes: "SSO group-sync race causes delegated_scope loss -> console 403 on project-switch".

on-call-bot: Incident INF-4821 created, priority=P2, owner=priya, status=open.

mira: Closing the support case for now (customer confirmed workaround). Please leave follow-up comments in INF-4821 if you pick up remediation.

samir: I'll draft KB: "Workaround: API key for immediate access; Root cause: SCIM group sync and session refresh race; Long term: session refresh policy + claim retention."

mira: Thanks all, ping me if it recurs.
